messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 12):
"""
General Terms and Conditions 2.1 Whether the product is Micro Insurance Product - Yes / No 2.2 Whether the Product is for any specific Distribution Channel like CSC, PoS 2.3 Whether the health product is offered to/through: [Answer YES/NO] 2.3.1 Individual/Group Individual/Group S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 2.3.1.1 On Family Floater basis YES / NO 2.3.1.2 On Individual basis YES/NO 2.3.1.3 Both Individual and Family Floater basis YES / NO 2.3.2 Specific geographic locations in India [if YES, specify the locations.] YES / NO 2.3.3 All geographic locations in India YES / NO 2.3.4 Rural population YES / NO 2.3.5 Micro Insurance Market Segment YES / NO 2.3.6 Category of base cover Health/Travel-Domestic/Travel - Overseas/Personal Accident / Critical Illness 2.3.7 Only Indemnity basis YES / NO 2.3.8 Only Assured Benefit basis YES / NO 2.3.9 Both Indemnity and Assured benefit Basis Yes/No 2.4 Specify the following:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Is a health insurance product that covers both individual and family floater policies considered a micro insurance product?","answer":"Yes, if the product is offered on both individual and family floater basis, it can be classified as a micro insurance product.","facts":["2.1 Whether the product is Micro Insurance Product - Yes / No","2.3.1.3 Both Individual and Family Floater basis YES / NO"]},{"question":"Can a health insurance product be sold only on an indemnity basis?","answer":"Yes, a product can be offered exclusively on an indemnity basis if the insurer chooses to do so.","facts":["2.3.7 Only Indemnity basis YES / NO"]}]}
